_comment: Short-circuit config for the ui-design-spec skill. Phases 0-1 are settled; skill jumps to Phase 2.
uiLibsSanctionedException: Syncfusion.Blazor is a DOCUMENTED OPTION for a future dataviz pass only (docs/uidesign-dataviz.md). Not a current dependency. Do not add it or any other component library without rammyps sign-off.
